title: The Operator Mismatch Problem: Deploying BEV Perception with Portable GPU Compute
abstract: arXiv:2610.11504v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern autonomous driving systems rely on bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception models that fuse camera and LiDAR inputs to detect objects in 3D space. These models are accurate, but they cannot be deployed through standard inference runtimes. The reason is an operator mismatch between dense convolutions (which runtimes handle well), sparse 3D convolutions (which runtimes cannot represent), and geometric scatter operations (which runtimes have no vocabulary for). Today, every sparse convolution library is CUDA-only and PyTorch-coupled, locking BEV deployment to a single vendor's hardware and a single execution framework.   We present BEVPIPE, a framework for deploying multimodal BEV perception pipelines using portable GPU compute APIs and integrating them with production inference runtimes. translated_title: 算子不匹配问题：使用可移植GPU计算部署鸟瞰图（BEV）感知
translated_abstract: 现代自动驾驶系统依赖于鸟瞰图（BEV）感知模型，该模型融合摄像头和激光雷达输入以检测三维空间中的物体。这些模型精度很高，但无法通过标准推理运行时进行部署。原因在于算子不匹配：密集卷积（运行时可以很好地处理）、稀疏3D卷积（运行时无法表示）以及几何散射操作（运行时缺乏相应的表达能力）。目前，所有稀疏卷积库都仅支持CUDA且与PyTorch耦合，这使得BEV部署被锁定在单一厂商的硬件和单一执行框架上。我们提出了BEVPIPE，这是一个利用可移植GPU计算API部署多模态BEV感知管线，并将其与生产级推理运行时集成的框架。BEVPIPE将模型划分为由运行时管理的密集子图和三个外部算子扩展（体素化器、稀疏编码器、BEV投影器）……
tldr: 本文提出BEVPIPE框架，通过将稀疏卷积和散射操作封装为可移植GPU算子扩展并与标准推理运行时集成，解决了BEV感知模型部署中的算子不匹配问题，摆脱了对单一硬件厂商和执行框架的依赖。
en_tdlr: BEVPIPE addresses the operator mismatch problem in BEV perception deployment by wrapping sparse convolutions and scatter operations as portable GPU operator extensions integrated with standard inference runtimes, freeing deployment from single-vendor hardware and framework lock-in.
